papers.title: GrowPage: On-Demand KV Budgeting for Efficient LLM Reasoning Serving
papers.abstract: Long-output reasoning has made the key--value (KV) cache a critical memory bottleneck for efficient LLM serving. papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates generation without changing its output, yet on vision-language models (VLMs) it has been caught in a self-defeating cycle. 方法：通过遥感技术自动生成大范围的场景特定信道模型，解决了传统信道建模的局限性，提高了无线通信的可靠性。
相关性：该研究与空间-空中-地面通信系统相关，创新点在于利用遥感数据提升信道建模的准确性，为边缘计算提供了更好的支持。
